raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 14 arrived with source_tz='UTC'; every earlier batch used America/Chicago local time. The pipeline ignores source_tz, so batch 14's evening transactions (18:00-23:00 CST on 2026-01-18) land as 00:00-05:00 on 2026-01-19. Its first sample row at 12:00 UTC is 06:00 CST, which matches the opening time seen in earlier batches. The fix normalizes UTC rows to Chicago local time; January is CST, a fixed UTC-6 offset, with no DST in this data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
